component.name: PaperFlow
component.summary: Privacy-first, fully on-device PDF management suite

description.p: PaperFlow is a modern, fast, and 100% offline PDF manager for Fedora Linux and Android. Unlike web services that upload sensitive files to remote servers, PaperFlow performs all PDF operations locally on your hardware.

ul.li: Merge multiple PDFs with custom ordering and page ranges
Split PDFs by custom page numbers, intervals, or burst into single pages
Visual interactive page organizer to reorder, rotate 90°, and delete pages
Smart compression with Extreme, Recommended, and High-Quality presets
Convert images (JPG, PNG, WebP) to PDF and rasterize PDFs to high-res images
Diagonal text watermark stamps with adjustable opacity and sizing
Fast interactive document viewer with zoom and direct printing

description.p: Initial release of PaperFlow with core offline PDF tools: Merge, Split, Organize, Compress, Image Conversion, and Watermark.
